queries (additional query suites)

e.g. security-extended, security-and-quality, or a path like ./my-queries

packs (CodeQL pack references)

Pick a language to scope the pack, or (any language). Mixing scoped and unscoped packs is not valid for codeql-config.

paths (include)
paths-ignore (exclude)
query-filters

Each filter is include or exclude keyed by tag/id (e.g. id: js/missing-rate-limiting).
